full_prompt_en: A square, softly rendered three-dimensional animated scene shows an elderly man, a boy, and a small turquoise creature seated in a garden before an old brick house. The background rises into a pale blue, lightly clouded sky, with the steep slate roof, cream trim, tall windows, and shaded porch of the house occupying the left and center. Foliage softens the building's edges, while a misty line of trees recedes at the right. Across the lower part of the frame, uneven sunlit grass and clusters of tiny violet flowers surround the seated group. The small creature rests closest to the viewer at lower left; its rounded, slightly ridged body and one oversized eye are modeled with smooth, softly reflective turquoise surfaces. Behind it, the brown-haired boy sits with his knees bent and hands near his legs. His checked reddish-brown top, shorts, and pale socks have simple readable folds, and his lifted face turns toward the man with an open, curious expression. On the right, the elderly man leans forward with his forearms resting on raised knees. A blue shirt, dark neckwear, brown trousers, heavy shoes, black rectangular glasses, and tousled gray hair distinguish his compact silhouette. His large nose and expressive brows are exaggerated gently, while warm pinks in the face keep the character approachable. The figures have rounded, substantial volume and carefully softened edges; finely textured grass and weathered brick add detail without breaking the clear character shapes. Warm daylight falls from the upper left, brightening hair, faces, shoulders, and grass tips while leaving cooler, soft shadows beneath the porch and around the seated bodies. The overall composition balances the close, colorful trio against a gently atmospheric house and garden, creating a quiet, affectionate animated moment.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形、柔和渲染的三维动画场景呈现一位老人、一个男孩和一只青绿色小生物，他们坐在老砖房前的花园里。背景向上延伸为带薄云的浅蓝天空，房屋陡斜的石板屋顶、奶油色饰边、高窗和阴影中的门廊占据左侧与中央。枝叶柔化建筑边缘，右侧一线树木则在薄雾中后退。画面下方，起伏的阳光草地和细小紫花簇拥着坐在一起的三个角色。小生物位于最靠近观者的左下方，圆润、略带环纹的身体和一只夸张的大眼睛由平滑、微微反光的青绿色表面塑形。它后面，棕发男孩屈膝坐着，双手靠近腿部。红棕色格纹上衣、短裤和浅色袜子带着简洁清晰的褶皱，他抬起脸望向老人，神情敞开而好奇。右边，老人前倾，前臂搭在抬起的膝盖上。蓝衬衫、深色颈饰、棕色长裤、厚实鞋子、黑色方框眼镜和蓬乱灰发构成鲜明而紧凑的剪影。他的大鼻子与富于表情的眉毛经过温和夸张，脸上的暖粉色又让人物显得亲近。角色形体圆润扎实，边缘经过细致柔化；细密的草叶和风化砖面增添细节，却不打破清楚的角色外形。温暖日光从左上方落下，提亮头发、面孔、肩膀和草尖，在门廊下与坐着的人物周围留下偏冷的柔软阴影。整体构图让近处鲜明的三位角色与带轻微空气感的房屋和花园平衡，形成安静而温情的动画瞬间。
style_prompt_en: The three-dimensional animated rendering favors rounded, clearly readable volumes with gently exaggerated proportions and expressive yet economical features. Smooth modeled surfaces hold soft highlights, while fine environmental texture adds tactile contrast without competing with the larger silhouettes. Warm brick reds, muted blue, fresh grass green, and small turquoise and violet accents are organized into broad, friendly color areas. Light is warm and directional but diffused enough to keep shadows open; cool atmospheric haze pushes distant forms back while sunlit edges bring the focal shapes forward. Contours are firm around the main volumes and progressively softer through surrounding fine textures and distance. A close group of interlocking shapes occupies the foreground, with a larger layered setting supplying scale and depth. The overall effect is cinematic, approachable, and gently whimsical, grounded by credible materials and restrained surface detail.
style_prompt_zh: 这种三维动画渲染偏重圆润、清晰可读的体积，以温和夸张的比例和简练而富表情的特征塑造形体。平滑的塑形表面承接柔软高光，细密环境肌理则提供可触的对比，却不争夺大轮廓的注意力。暖砖红、低调蓝、鲜草绿及少量青绿与紫色重音组织成宽阔而亲切的色域。光线温暖且有方向，经过足够漫射让阴影保持通透；冷调空气薄雾推远远处形体，受光边缘则把焦点形状带向前方。主要体块轮廓明确，周围细密肌理及远景逐渐柔化。近景中一组互相咬合的形状占据主体，更大的层叠环境提供尺度与纵深。整体效果具有电影感、亲和力与轻微奇趣，并由可信的材质和克制的表面细节稳住。

theme_zh: 老人、男孩与青绿色小生物坐在老房子前
